title: Graduated vested allowances + SQ-triggered onboarding for team accounts
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Problem: Our current starter allowances (one-off credits) drive early usage but show high churn and low conversion for multi-user/team accounts. Enterprise teams request predictable, audit-friendly onboarding and often stall MQL->SQ handoff because credit expiry and feature gating are misaligned with procurement cycles.

Hypothesis: Introducing ‘graduated vested allowances’ — a time-phased credit vesting schedule tied to feature unlocks and a security-questionnaire (SQ) trigger — will increase team activation velocity and improve PLG->sales conversion while surfacing enterprise security needs earlier. Specifically, teams receiving a staged pool of credits that unlock over 30 days and see progressive feature flags (collaboration, SSO preview, dedicated usage view) will be more likely to: (a) invite teammates, (b) complete basic security questionnaire when prompted, and (c) request a contract/paid plan before credits fully expire.

Behavioral attachment: For accounts that trigger the SQ (e.g., >50k tokens used or >3 seats invited) we will surface an inline SQ CTA and optionally route the account to AE outreach if they meet enterprise thresholds. This should reduce friction on procurement and reduce the number of enterprise accounts that stall due to unclear entitlement windows.
experiment_variants: Control: existing single-grant starter credit (5k tokens, 14-day expiry), baseline UX

V1 - Vesting schedule: total 15k tokens split as 5k immediate + 5k unlock at day 7 + 5k unlock at day 21 (30-day window). Feature unlocks: invite seat + basic collaboration unlocked at first vest, SSO preview enabled at second vest.
V2 - Accelerated for engaged teams: same vesting as V1 but expiry extended to 45 days if team invites >=2 members within first 14 days.
V3 - SQ-triggered flow: same as V1 but if usage >50k tokens or seats >3 within 30 days, surface inline SQ modal and mark for AE routing; SQ completion grants 10k bonus credit that vests immediately.
metrics: activation_rate_7d: percent of new team orgs that create >1 project within 7 days
invite_rate_14d: percent of orgs that invite >=1 teammate within 14 days
sq_completion_rate: percent of triggered orgs that finish security questionnaire
plg_to_paid_conversion_60d: percent of experiment orgs converted to paid within 60 days
net_token_spend_per_org_30d: median tokens consumed in first 30 days
support_contacts_from-experiment: number of support tickets related to credits/expiry
success_criteria: Increase invite_rate_14d by >=12% (relative) and improve plg_to_paid_conversion_60d by >=8% for V1 or V3 versus control. SQ completion rate target >=40% for triggered enterprise candidates. No more than 10% increase in support volume attributable to credit confusion.
implementation_notes: Backend: implement vesting ledger entries and token-unlock triggers; ensure idempotency and audit logs for each vest event
Console: new UX modules for progressive feature unlock states and inline SQ CTA; copy variations for experiment cohorts
Routing: add AE-routing flag when org meets enterprise thresholds (usage/seats) and SQ not completed
Safety: add guardrails to prevent accidental double-credit grants across promotions
Observability: dashboard with cohort breakdowns, token burn curves, SQ funnel, and error rates for vesting job
